description: Na₂CrNiF₇ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Imma space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to eight F atoms to form distorted NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent CrF₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent CrF₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent NiF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 54°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.75 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight F atoms. There are four shorter (2.41 Å) and four longer (2.70 Å) Na-F bond lengths. Cr is bonded to six F atoms to form CrF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids, corners with four equivalent NiF₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 43°. There are four shorter (1.91 Å) and two longer (1.93 Å) Cr-F bond lengths. Ni is bonded to six F atoms to form NiF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NiF₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent CrF₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-48°. There are two shorter (1.95 Å) and four longer (1.98 Å) Ni-F bond lengths. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Cr atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Cr tetrahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Ni atoms. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Cr, and one Ni atom.
